revenue_events_ranges.name: revenue_events_ranges
revenue_events_ranges.value: "revenue_events"."orders" >= 0 and "revenue_events"."gross_minor" >= 0 and "revenue_events"."refund_minor" >= 0 and ("revenue_events"."fees_minor" is null or "revenue_events"."fees_minor" >= 0) and "revenue_events"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

keyword_metric_snapshots_ranges.name: keyword_metric_snapshots_ranges
keyword_metric_snapshots_ranges.value:
("keyword_metric_snapshots"."search_volume" is null or "keyword_metric_snapshots"."search_volume" >= 0)
        and ("keyword_metric_snapshots"."cpc_micros" is null or "keyword_metric_snapshots"."cpc_micros" >= 0)
        and ("keyword_metric_snapshots"."ads_competition" is null or "keyword_metric_snapshots"."ads_competition" between 0 and 100)
        and ("keyword_metric_snapshots"."keyword_difficulty" is null or "keyword_metric_snapshots"."keyword_difficulty" between 0 and 100)

opportunity_evaluations_ranges.name: opportunity_evaluations_ranges
opportunity_evaluations_ranges.value: "opportunity_evaluations"."score" between 0 and 100 and "opportunity_evaluations"."confidence" between 0 and 100 and "opportunity_evaluations"."rank" >= 1
